posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Revo Corp is reportedly just off stage for Fixer's incapacitated side, but that is just a rumor.

Revo Corp was seen with a mysterious friend at the annual "Villain Initiative for Cooperation with Environments Annual Banquet and Awards Ceremony," Revo Corp refused to comment on whether it would follow its close personal Friend Pike Industrial Complex and attempt to make it as an Environment deck, or if it is content to remain a motivation and backstory.

Despite the hush hush nature of its involvement speculation is running rampant over the roll it will decide to play.

It did comment on the announcement that Mobile Defense Platform would make a successful crossover into becoming an environment deck, stating:  "We couldn't be prouder of MDP, making this transition from villain support to hosting its own environment will be an inspiration for future generations of both Villains and Environments, this is truly a Watershed moment for the relationship of Villains and Environments, and for this cooperative"  When asked about the news that Freedom Tower would also be an Environment deck Revo Corp stated it had no comment, but later submitted this official statement:  "It is disheartening to see the continued abuse of Environmental neutrality and independence by the Hero establishment.  It is increasingly clear that the Freedom Initiative is nothing more than an agent of oppression which has no respect for the independence of Environments, nor the creativity and ingenuity of non-traditional innovators like our illustrious friend Baron Blade."

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
Proof DW Fixer is a zombie!

  • Zombies deal 3 melee damage when H=5. DW Fixer also deals 3 melee damage when H=5.
  • With Grease Monker Fist, Fixer can deal Fire or Infernal damage, who else does those damage? The greatest, most attractive cultist to ever walk the Multiverse, the Cursed Acolyte. What happens when one someone manages to destroy the might Cursed Acolyte? He comes back as a zombie!
  • The Profane Zealot has a DR of 1. Fixer has a DR of 1 with the Pipe Wrench. What happens when someone kills the Profane Zealot? He becomes a zombie!
  • The Chosen Disciple retrieves zombies from the trash and deals more damage because of it. Fixer can play Salvage yard to retrieve Equipment cards and also Overdrive, meaning he gets to deal more damage because of it. What happens when Chosen Disciple is destroyed? She turns into a zombie!
  • DW Fixer has a dragon tattoo on his chest. One may refer to dragons as being of the serpent persuasion. Snakes are of course serpents. What snake do we know about? Ophidia the Deciever, who works for GloomWeaver. GloomWeaver also happens to be a master of zombies!
  • Dw Fixer has his eyes covered, because he uses his super hearing and smell for the environment. What else has been known to rely on those same senses? Zombies!
  • If you drop off all letters in the Mister Fixer, besides a M, I, and E, you will be left with "MIE". Adding a Z and O before that and a B inbetween the M and I, you will get ZOMBIE!
  • DW Fixer is not wearing a shirt, zombies are also commonly found without shirts.
  • Fixer primarly fights using his hands. Zombies are also qutie fond of unarmed combat.
  • Fixer has been stabbed in the chest and is seen standing afterwards. Zombies can get stabbed into the chest and continue to stand.
